user.title: Choose whole-home meter
user.description: Select the HA power sensor that represents total whole-home consumption. Energy Attribution will automatically adopt the filtered electrical-load candidates into its private environment. You will choose what to monitor later from Configure.

init.title: Electrical-load commissioning
init.description: {count} potential electrical-load devices were found and adopted into the Energy Attribution environment. All are selected by default. Uncheck anything you do not want monitored, then submit. You can reopen this screen later from Configure.

abort.no_candidates: No electrical-load candidates were found after filtering.
